description: This PHP class 'LeaveRequestDecorator' provides additional functionalities for the LeaveRequest entity, such as setting employee and leave type by ID, retrieving formatted application date, and fetching the last comment associated with the leave request.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class enhancing the LeaveRequest entity with additional methods for setting related entities and retrieving specific data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decorator with a specific LeaveRequest entity.

methods.name: getLeaveRequest
methods.description: Protected method returning the associated LeaveRequest entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity for the leave request based on employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the LeaveType entity for the leave request based on leave type ID.

methods.name: getDateApplied
methods.description: Returns the date when the leave was applied for, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLastComment
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent comment associated with the leave request.
